name: PDF Snapshot Archive API
description: Extends the REDCap API to list and download items from the PDF Snapshot Archive folder of the File Repository.

list-items.description: Lists every item in the PDF Snapshot Archive visible to the token's user. Returns item_id, filename, and record for each item. Optionally filter with the record parameter. Supports returnFormat json (default) or csv.

get-item.description: Returns every attribute of the PDF Snapshot Archive item specified by item_id, except the file itself. Supports returnFormat json (default) or csv.

get-file.description: Downloads the PDF file of the PDF Snapshot Archive item specified by item_id.
